fireside.text: "Nobody's sleeping. The sky is waiting and nobody knows what to do with their hands."

fireside.speaker: Habiba

tableLines.line: 💔 A faction of Thornfield has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 3 people under Amara.
📓 Codex: Thornfield split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 3 petition at Haven's fire.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Sidney speaks at Stonebridge's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table II is a new fire in the world now — 3 people under Ben.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
You see smoke on the horizon. The Red Table II — 3 people, 29 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 8 plants — 7 new to you. They've been here the whole time.

You see smoke on the horizon. The Red Table — 6 people, 29 days in. foragers, by the look of it. They know 10 plants — 8 new to you. They look lean — hungry, even. Food would talk here. They've been here the whole time.
🧳 A traveler says Thornfield burned — the whole fire, gone. (Wrong. It split: the eaters walked. The Red Table is the new fire.)

Fresh-cut stems on the west ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (The Red Table II's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)
A runner from The Red Table II, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the west ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)

The west ground is thinning faster than your crews alone could strip it. The Red Table II isn't slowing down — their foragers are on your turf most days now. Their speaker would probably want words. (Talk about the shared ground at their fire.)
Word later: they walked to The Red Table II. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
The Red Table II's speaker sent a runner: the west ground feeds both villages or neither. They want to talk — properly, at their fire. Ignoring this is also an answer.
🧳 Emberhold has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table II. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.

🌙 Raid — The Red Table II came in the night from the west. They carried off ~1200 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and
You caught the lie in his face and watched the whole table react to it before he'd finished the sentence. Face and room, both open books.
